name: What preparations should I make before listing my luxury home?

mainEntity.name: What preparations should I make before listing my luxury home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before listing, consider professional staging, minor repairs, and decluttering to maximize appeal. High-end homes benefit significantly from a pristine presentation. This includes ensuring all systems, such as HVAC and smart home technology, are fully functional. Your agent from Realty ONE Group Evolution can provide a specific checklist and recommendations tailored to the Miami-Dade, Broward, Palm Beach, Collier, or Orange County luxury market, highlighting key features to emphasize for potential buyers.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prepare your luxury home by professional staging, decluttering, and making necessary repairs. A local agent can provide a tailored checklist for your market.
